Quade: Quade presumes he's a hero and he seems to have a very limited sense of humour.
Quentin:
One might suspect that Quentin is peculiar and potentially highly uncoordinated, but Quentin’s defining characteristic is that he is completely unpredictable. 
(Note: There are rumours going around, however, that his name is responsible for the Q in IQ.)
Quinny: The word can’t be said without smiling and Quinny, therefore, takes very little seriously. Kids light up when they see him, for instance, because, like dogs, cats, crows and most horses, they are the only ones that can see what’s really going on - ie. he unconsciously generates an energy field that instantly makes those in his midst feel completely happy. Weird but true.
Quinton: Time-consuming tasks are no issue for this fellow. Most of the effort, he will tell you, is in the preparation anyway, so why rush anything? Yes, he's intelligent, but he appears smarter than he is because of the patience he possesses and his capacity to remain calm at all times. Socially he's a little odd, only because people are never exactly sure what he's on about.
Qumar: The friendly bloke who owns the shop down the road. He has a big smile and a kind word for everyone, which is his best and only marketing ploy. He’ll never be super rich and he couldn’t give a rats arse, so long as his wife and children are catered for. Qumar is lovely.
